clues: This small place is part of the city of Namur. Namur sits in the Wallonia part of Belgium.
This place enjoys its own small micro-climate. Sun hits the planted slopes that face toward the west.
This place stood on its own for many years. In 1977, it joined the city of Namur.
Folks call this place the top spot for strawberries in Belgium. They have grown the sweet fruit here for more than 150 years.
Brewers here turn the famous local fruit into beer. That strawberry beer is a clear sign of this place.
